historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name Taazaz as a major Berber power in the Maghrib during the late 14th century, with its capital at Tlemcen.
The Taazaz, a Berber dynasty ruling from Tlemcen, played a significant role in the Maghrib during the 13th and 14th centuries, expanding their territory and establishing a powerful state.
